entries.text: Databricks SQL connections (which carry a personal access token), hosted result submission (which carries a bearer token), and the stdlib downloads for expected results, flight data, NYC taxi data and the Redshift public-IP lookup now verify TLS against the `certifi` bundle instead of the interpreter's system store. On uv-managed Python for macOS that store is `/etc/ssl/cert.pem`, which Apple does not update and which still trusted the compromised eMudhra emSign roots. Set `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` or `SSL_CERT_FILE` to a PEM file to trust a corporate CA instead.
